title: Deal Score V1 Formulation and Deterministic Turkish Verdicts
context: Need an objective, transparent formula to judge whether an Xbox discount is actually a genuine deal.
decision: Implement Deal Score V1 with 4 weighted factors totaling 100 points, mapped to 5 deterministic Turkish verdicts.
consequences: Deterministic, auditable deal calculations (55% low proximity, 20% discount, 15% rarity, 10% momentum)
Turkish verdict tiers (Kaçırma, Çok İyi, İyi, Bekle, Zayıf Fırsat) provide instant actionable insight
risks: In early days when price history is sparse, confidence score must be displayed alongside deal score.
